## Correlation 
```{r}
common_table <- inner_join(f1_ddm1_effect,f1_Col0_effect, by=c("chromosome", "position") )

ggplot(common_table, aes(effsize.y, effsize.x))+geom_point()+facet_wrap(~chromosome)+xlab("F1 Col effect size") + ylab("F1 ddm1 effect size")


ggplot(f1_Col0_effect, aes(-log10(pv10), -log10(pv20)))+geom_point()+facet_wrap(~chromosome)+xlab("-log10 F1 ddm1")+ylab("-log10 F1 ddm1 X F1 Col0")
```


```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Filter for the two main environments/traits
df_wide <- df %>%
  filter(env %in% c("env0_env0_0", "env1_env1_0")) %>%
  dplyr::select(effect_name, chromosome, position, env, effsize) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = env, values_from = effsize)

# Rename columns for clarity
colnames(df_wide)[colnames(df_wide) == "env0_env0_0"] <- "trait1_effsize"
colnames(df_wide)[colnames(df_wide) == "env1_env1_0"] <- "trait2_effsize"

head(df_wide)
```


```{r}
plot(
  df_wide$trait1_effsize, df_wide$trait2_effsize,
  xlab = "SNP effect on Trait 1",
  ylab = "SNP effect on Trait 2",
  main = "SNP effect sizes: Trait 1 vs Trait 2",
  pch = 20, col = rgb(0,0,1,0.5)
)
abline(h=0, v=0, lty=2, col="grey")
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Trait 1 Manhattan plot
ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = position, y = abs(trait1_effsize), color = chromosome)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Manhattan plot: Trait 1", x = "Position", y = "|Effect size|") +
  theme_minimal()

# Trait 2 Manhattan plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = position, y = (effsize), color = chromosome)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Manhattan plot: Trait 2", x = "Position", y = "|Effect size|") +
  theme_minimal()+facet_wrap(~chromosome, nrow=1)
```

```{r}
df_wide %>%
  filter(abs(trait1_effsize) > 0.05 | abs(trait2_effsize) > 0.05)
```
